choices.label: Ask an Adult to Explain Echoes

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children delight in hearing their voices return.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Nobody can agree who won because the echo changes every song.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The children learn how sound reflects.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (adult) admits they cannot explain every strange sound.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A playful cave-spirit story becomes a favorite.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) worries until (storyteller) clarifies it is pretend.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The group returns later with a quieter game.
